title_en: 2+1+2 apartment for sale in Tirana Trio Towers Residential Complex, Don Bosko.

Tirana Trio Towers Residence was designed by one of the best architectural studios, which has thought in detail about the well-being and comfort of the residents of this residential complex. This complex has maintained standards based on EU parameters, in which it is said that one elevator covers up to 4 residential apartments.
